calda-toroid.name: Calda Toroid
calda-toroid.description:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Calda Toroids from enemies located at the Enrichment Labs in the Orb Vallis and from Scyto Raknoids. They can also be found as pick-ups in caves located around the Orb Vallis (Venus).

carbides.name: Carbides
carbides.description:
Resilient components used to reinforce the plated sheets of metal strapped to Grineer Ships.

Location: Eximus units in the Grineer Shipyard Tileset, and Railjack missions in Earth, Saturn, and Veil Proximas

cephalite-resonance.name: Cephalite Resonance
cephalite-resonance.description: Cephalite Resonance used to enter the Glassmaker's Weave

cerulean-fungus-extract.name: Cerulean Fungus Extract
cerulean-fungus-extract.description: Extracted from a Cerulean Fungus colony.

cetus-wisp.name: Cetus Wisp
cetus-wisp.description:
Most common at night, these stone lifeforms are drawn to shorelines touched by the Eidolon. They linger around lakes on the Plains of Eidolon at all hours. Their origin remains mysterious.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth

cheddar-crowns-cereal.name: Cheddar Crowns Cereal
cheddar-crowns-cereal.description:
A nostalgic treat for the ultimate ‘90s kid! Remember those commercials with the cheerful mouse quartet? Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)

chuggin-along-sixpack.name: Chuggin' Along Sixpack
chuggin-along-sixpack.description:
A set of liquid comfort perfect for anyone who deserves a moment to unwind. Ideal for someone carrying the weight of the world on their shoulders. Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)

condroc-wing.name: Condroc Wing
condroc-wing.description:
The talon on a condroc's wing is sharp enough to tear through bone.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth

connla-sprout.name: Connla Sprout
connla-sprout.description:
The water that courses through Connla Sprouts tastes sweet and refreshing.

Location: Duviri

copernics.name: Copernics
copernics.description:
A cell of encapsulated Void energy.

Location: Lua

coprun.name: Coprun
coprun.description:
A soft, malleable metal.

Location: Plains of Eidolon (Earth) from Red Mining Veins

corpus-cipher.name: Corpus Cipher
corpus-cipher.description: A cipher used to decode Corpus intel. Crafting component required to create a CORPUS VOID KEY

corpus-datamass.name: Corpus Datamass
corpus-datamass.description: A Corpus datamass containing encrypted intel. Crafting component required to create a CORPUS VOID KEY

crimson-talent.name: Crimson Talent
crimson-talent.description:
A weighty token from Orion's broken future. 

Source: Support Vena against Ryoku (Scoria's Angel, Uranus Proxima)

crimzian.name: Crimzian
crimzian.description:
A blood-red gem.

Location: Plains of Eidolon (Earth) from Blue Mining Veins and Thumpers

crisma-toroid.name: Crisma Toroid
crisma-toroid.description:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Crisma Toroids by defeating the Profit-Taker Orb on the Orb Vallis (Venus).

cryptographic-alu.name: Cryptographic Alu
cryptographic-alu.description:
Excess circuitry disposed of during the Razorback manufacturing process, these components only appear in the vicinity of high level outer-orbit Corpus facilities after a Razorback Armada has been launched.

Location: Corpus Archwing units on Jupiter and Neptune when a Razorback Armada is active

cubic-diodes.name: Cubic Diodes
cubic-diodes.description:
Vital components used in the creation of Corpus photon-networks.

Location: Eximus units in the Corpus Ice Planet Tileset, and Railjack missions in Venus, Neptune, and Pluto Proximas

curse-of-hearing.name: Curse Of Hearing
curse-of-hearing.description:
This curse contains knowledge that will help Fibonacci prevent enemies from breaking free of The Sanctum. Feed curses to the Jahu Gargoyle in your Clan Dojo to re-calibrate its defensive capabilities.

Location: Effervo (Deimos) during Operation Gargoyle's Cry

curse-of-knowing.name: Curse Of Knowing
curse-of-knowing.description:
This curse contains knowledge that will help Fibonacci prevent enemies from breaking free of The Sanctum. Feed curses to the Jahu Gargoyle in your Clan Dojo to re-calibrate its defensive capabilities.

Location: Effervo (Deimos) during Operation Gargoyle's Cry

curse-of-seeing.name: Curse Of Seeing
curse-of-seeing.description:
This curse contains knowledge that will help Fibonacci prevent enemies from breaking free of The Sanctum. Feed curses to the Jahu Gargoyle in your Clan Dojo to re-calibrate its defensive capabilities.

Location: Effervo (Deimos) during Operation Gargoyle's Cry
